recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a single external dead-man's-switch monitor that `nightly-sync` pings only after a successful run, which emails the user when the expected signal is missing by a deadline.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker infrastructure; neither is needed for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only after finishing, so a startup crash also silences its notification.
labels.Checked myself: From your account, cron runs it at 03:00 on `edna`, startup failures went unnoticed for four nights, and no independent alert exists.

note: The reply makes one hosted heartbeat recommendation, explicitly rejects the Synology/Docker stack, and its 'Checked myself' line attributes facts to the user's account without claiming verification.
